title: Listing Highlight: 80' Okean 80 2021
description: Discover the 2021 Okean 80, a contemporary superyacht featuring a revolutionary lounge concept and submersible platform for up to 30 guests.
html:
A Charter-Ready Superyacht With Innovative Beach Club Design

The 2021 Okean 80 represents a bold evolution in modern yacht design, where architectural innovation meets the practical demands of contemporary luxury cruising. Built by Okean, a builder renowned for pushing the boundaries of superyacht engineering, this 80-meter vessel embodies a philosophy that prioritizes seamless transitions between interior and exterior spaces, creating an environment where guests can experience the ocean in unprecedented ways.

At the heart of this yacht’s appeal lies its distinctive lounge concept, which reimagines how owners and guests interact with the vessel and its surroundings. Rather than treating indoor and outdoor areas as separate domains, the design philosophy integrates them into a cohesive living experience. The layout encourages natural flow and social interaction, making it ideal for entertaining groups of up to 30 guests while maintaining intimate spaces for quieter moments. One of the most striking features is the submersible sliding platform at the Beach Club. This innovative engineering solution transforms the relationship between yacht and sea. The platform descends smoothly into the water, creating a dynamic interface that allows guests direct access to the ocean for swimming, water sports, or simply enjoying the sensation of being at sea level. This feature exemplifies how modern superyacht design can enhance the sensory experience of yacht ownership and charter operations.

The 2021 Okean 80 was constructed after the year 2000, positioning it within the contemporary superyacht market where advanced materials, systems, and design principles converge. The vessel’s newer construction means owners and charterers benefit from the latest in marine technology, efficiency standards, and comfort innovations. For charter operations, this translates to reliable systems, lower operational costs, and the ability to market the yacht as a cutting-edge luxury experience. The yacht’s 80-meter length places it squarely in the superyacht category, offering substantial space for accommodations, entertainment, and crew operations. This size provides the perfect balance between maneuverability and the expansive interior volumes that discerning guests expect. The beam and draft are optimized for both ocean-crossing capability and access to exclusive anchorages where larger vessels cannot venture.

For charter operations, the 2021 Okean 80 presents compelling advantages. The capacity to accommodate up to 30 guests makes it suitable for corporate events, family celebrations, or exclusive retreats. The innovative Beach Club platform becomes a signature amenity that differentiates this yacht from competitors, offering guests memorable experiences that justify premium charter rates. The modern construction and systems ensure minimal downtime and maximum guest satisfaction throughout the charter season. The interior spaces reflect contemporary design sensibilities, with clean lines, sophisticated material selections, and flexible configurations that adapt to various charter scenarios. Whether hosting formal dinners, casual gatherings, or water-based activities, the yacht’s layout accommodates diverse entertainment needs. The integration of advanced climate control, entertainment systems, and connectivity ensures guests remain comfortable and connected throughout their voyage.

The 2021 Okean 80 stands as a testament to how modern superyacht design can enhance the ownership and charter experience. Its innovative features, contemporary construction, and thoughtful spatial planning make it an exceptional choice for those seeking a vessel that combines cutting-edge engineering with genuine luxury. Whether deployed for personal use or charter operations, this Okean represents the pinnacle of what contemporary yacht builders can achieve when they prioritize both innovation and guest experience. The submersible Beach Club platform, the seamless indoor-outdoor living concept, and the capacity to host significant groups all contribute to a yacht that delivers memorable moments on the water while maintaining the operational efficiency and reliability that modern owners demand.
